This ERC-funded project at Bocconi University studies how markets can address environmental challenges amid information frictions and behavioral biases. It combines field experiments, administrative data and surveys to assess interventions and policies, focusing on carbon emissions, air pollution, extreme heat and AI’s role in environmental markets. Working with the Principal Investigator, the postdoc will lead research on air pollution and heat exposure, examining people’s responses to and understanding of health risks. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Autonomous agricultural robotics, computer vision, and spectral cameras for the detection and treatment of pathological and entomological diseases in fruit tree crops, within the framework of Agriculture 4.0. (Univ. BARI)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-04 Ingegneria agraria, forestale e dei biosistemi

The research activities will focus on the development and implementation of integrated systems—combining autonomous robotics, computer vision, and spectral sensing—for the protection of fruit tree crops. These activities will be conducted in orchards representative of various species, cultivars, cultivation systems, and production conditions. Autonomous platforms equipped with sensors, computer vision systems, and multispectral or hyperspectral cameras will collect field data to enable the early detection of symptoms of plant diseases and pest infestations. item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-11 23:55
Institution: Univ. BARI, Roma
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-04 Ingegneria agraria, forestale e dei biosistemi

The successful candidate will be involved in the development, configuration, and software management of optical systems operating in the visible (VIS) and near-infrared (NIR) ranges, as well as in multispectral mode, designed for the characterization of olives and the monitoring of olive oil processing. Tasks will include defining data acquisition protocols, interfacing with cameras and spectroscopic sensors, synchronizing and archiving data, and calibrating and standardizing measurements. Algorithms will be developed for signal pre-processing, the analysis of images and spectral data, and the extraction of significant features. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: THE PERCEPTION OF SOCIOECONOMIC AND TOURISTIC DAMAGE CAUSED BY MACROPLASTICS IN MOUNTAIN ENVIRONMENTS: A CASE STUDY IN THE MOLISE REGION (Univ. MOLISE)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-30 23:59
Institution: Univ. MOLISE, Roma
Field: Agriculture and veterinary science / 07/AGRI-01 Economia agraria, alimentare ed estimo rurale

The research program aims to analyze the perception of the socioeconomic damage caused by waste—macroplastics—in mountain environments by various stakeholders in the context under study (Alto Molise), and the factors that can stimulate "virtuous" behavior. Furthermore, it aims to investigate knowledge of the phenomena, attitudes, and behaviors related to the waste problem in mountain contexts to measure the perception of damage. The study will also assess opinions on the impact that the presence of plastic waste can have on tourism.
